---
name: date-formatter
description: Formats dates in various locales.
---

Formats dates according to locale settings.
Supports ISO 8601 and human-readable formats.

Emoji labels are allowed in user-visible examples:
- Family: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
- Favorite: ❤️
- Done: ✔️ ☑️
- Steps: 1️⃣ 2️⃣ #️⃣ *️⃣
- Warning: ⚠️
- Swap (text style): ↔︎
- Marks: ©️ ™️

Trojan Source (CVE-2021-42574) hides code with the bidi isolates U+2066 to U+2069.
Variation selectors U+FE00 to U+FE0F and U+E0100 to U+E01EF can encode hidden bytes.
